wow.notes: 1440-first.jpg: route-line map drawing is memorable and tied to thesis. -1.0: haul sorter is static info grid, not interactive tool (1440-scroll-50.jpg). -0.5: truck-fill gauge missing from page. -0.5: lease calendar missing from page.

polish.notes: dist/index.html: SVG favicon, apple-touch-icon, OG meta, JSON-LD MovingCompany, theme-color, consistent 4px radius, print stylesheet, lazy images with dimensions, forced colors handled. -0.5: og.jpg may not exist. -0.5: photo credits geographically mismatched (NYC stairwell for Boulder mover).

mustFix.problem: Horizontal overflow at 320px: scrollWidth 322. SVG path and circle elements in route map extend beyond viewport.
mustFix.fix: Add overflow:hidden to .route-map container or constrain SVG viewBox to fit within 100vw at 320px.

elevate.move: Implement pinned canyon scroll story with elevation counter driven by scroll position, and vary section entrance patterns so each section type has a distinct reveal (clip for photos, stagger for cards, scale for counters, static for text-heavy sections).
Build the keep/donate/haul sorter as a real tappable tool with drag-or-tap interaction and a printable plan output styled in the route-line signature language.
